name: Morris Dancer Bernard

intro.text: Bells on my shins, sticks in my hands and a hanky in my pocket. You may well regret asking.

win: Oh, dear. A bell has come off. It happens to the best of us, usually in the middle of a figure.
after: The Cotswold Morris is danced in white with baldricks and bells. The Adderbury and Bampton sides are famous. They dance on the first of May, and the sun is persuaded to come up.
